rules.description: Linux (IT layout): Keypad period => '.'
Linux (IT layout): AltGr + i-grave produces tilde (~)
Linux (IT layout): AltGr + apostrophe produces backtick (`)
Linux: Ctrl + Backspace deletes word by word (Option + Delete), Ctrl variant used natively in Ghostty
Linux: Ctrl + Del (forward delete) deletes word by word (Option + Forward Delete)
Linux: Ctrl + Left/Right moves word by word (Option + Left/Right); excluded apps handle this natively
Linux (Terminal/IDE): Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right switch Spaces (Cmd+Opt+Arrow) -- restores workspace switch where Cmd<->Ctrl swap is off (UTM intentionally excluded)
Linux: Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right selects word by word (Option + Shift); excluded apps handle this natively
Linux: End key moves to end of line (Command + Right); Terminal/JetBrains/UTM/Ghostty handle Home/End natively
Linux: Home key moves to start of line (Command + Left); Terminal/JetBrains/UTM/Ghostty handle Home/End natively
Linux: Shift + End selects to end of line (Command + Shift + Right); Terminal/JetBrains/UTM/Ghostty handle Home/End natively
Linux: Shift + Home selects to start of line (Command + Shift + Left); Terminal/JetBrains/UTM/Ghostty handle Home/End natively
Linux (Terminal): Home key moves to start of line (Ctrl + A) -- Apple Terminal only, other terminals handle Home natively
Linux (Terminal): End key moves to end of line (Ctrl + E) -- Apple Terminal only, other terminals handle End natively
Linux (Terminal): Ctrl + Backspace deletes word by word (Ctrl + W) -- Apple Terminal only
Linux (Terminal): Ctrl + Left/Right moves word by word (Option + Left/Right) -- Apple Terminal only
Linux (Terminal): Shift + Ctrl + C copies (Command + C) -- Apple Terminal & Ghostty
Linux (Terminal): Shift + Ctrl + V pastes (Command + V) -- Apple Terminal & Ghostty
Linux (Browsers): F5 reloads page (Command + R) -- Firefox/Zen intentionally omitted, F5 already reloads natively there
Linux (Browsers): Option + Left/Right Arrow navigates history (Command + Left/Right)
Linux (Finder): F2 renames files and Enter opens files
Linux: Option + F4 quits the frontmost application (Command + Q)
Linux: Ctrl + Alt + T opens Ghostty terminal
Pass-through: Cmd+Space and Ctrl+Space (both left & right keys) stay untouched by the Cmd<->Ctrl swap below
Linux: Swap Left & Right Command and Control (excluding Terminal/JetBrains/UTM/Ghostty) -- MUST STAY LAST: remaps physical modifier keys, every rule above matches against the un-swapped ones
